messages.subject: Error in prior and control.predictor
parts:
> priors <- list(
+   beta = c(0, 0.001),
+   sigma = list(
+     prior = "loggamma",
+     param = c(1, 0.01)
+   ),
+   phi = list(
+     prec = 0.1,
+     initial = 0,
+     group = "phi"
+   )
+ )
> m <- inla(f, data = data,
+           family = "poisson",
+           control.compute = list(dic = TRUE),
+           control.inla = list(strategy = "adaptive", priors = priors),
+           control.fixed = list(priors = priors$beta),
+           control.family = list(priors = priors$sigma),
+           control.mode = list(n.mcmc = 5000),
+           control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE, priors = priors$phi))

Error in inla.check.control(control.predictor, data) :
  Name `priors' in control-argument `control.predictor', is void.

How can I modify this script?
